title: Tiny RM2k3 bugfix: Fix disappearing faces in battle on skill selection

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
User ZENWARECO brought to my attention that sometimes the faces during battle in Type C battle mode would still disappear (which I originally believed I fixed in v1.11), it turns out this happens when you enter the target selection for a skill but then cancel it using Esc instead of actually executing the skill. I created this small patch to fix this issue.
Download here:
https://cherryshare.at/f/2CBXKX/RPG_RT_GaugeSkillWindowFix2.ips
Note: This patch is
only
compatible with RPG Maker 2003 v1.12a, not any previous version and not Maniacs patch.
To apply,
back up your game's RPG_RT.exe file
, then use the tool
Lunar IPS
(select "All files" when asked for ROM files) to apply the IPS file to your game's RPG_RT.exe file.
